Package neqsim.process.equipment.splitter

Class Splitter.TransientState

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.splitter.Splitter.TransientState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
Splitter
public static final class Splitter.TransientState extends Object implements Serializable
Bounded hydraulic checkpoint retaining stream identities and all transient caches/configuration. The inlet is an independent graph participant, as for native hydraulic valves.
